ART ESTABLISHMENTS AND OPERATIONS, OFTITLE5, BUSINESS

AND REQUIREMENTS FOR PARTICIPATING BODY ARTISTS AND
GUEST BODY ARTISTS."
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING:
Section1.Thatvarious sections within Chapter 5.68, Body Art Establishments and
Operations, of Title5, Business Licenses and Regulations, ofthe Cheyenne City Code are hereby
amended asset forth in this ordinance to provide for a body art special event business license and
requirements for participating body artists and guest body artists.Existing sections contained
within Chapter5.68not set forthwith in this ordinance remain unchanged.
5.68.020
Definitions.
"GUESTARTIST"MEANS A BODY ARTIST WHO OBTAINS A GUEST ARTIST
PERMIT ISSUED BY THE CITY-COUNTY HEALTH OFFICER TO PROVIDE
TEMPORARY BODY ARTIST SERVICES IN CONJUNCTION WITH AND
PURSUANT TO A LICENSED BODY ART SPECIAL EVENT, A LICENSED BODY
ART ESTABLISHMENT OR A TEMPORARY BODY ART ESTABLISHMENT.THE
SHALL COINCIDE WITH THE BODY ART SPECIAL EVENT BUSINESS LICENSE
TIMEFRAME AND WILL BE VALID FOR NOT MORE THAN SEVEN
CONSECUTIVE DAYS, ORPORTION THEREOF.THE HEALTH OFFICERS HALL
NOT ISSUE MORE THAN FOUR PERMITS FOR THE SAME APPLICANT PER
CALENDAR YEAR.
“BODY ART SPECIAL EVENT"MEANS A CONVENTION，TRADESHOW,
EDUCATIONAL SHOW, PRODUCT DEMONSTRATION OR SIMILAR ACTIVITY
INVOLVING BODY ART AND/OR BODY ART ESTABLISHMENT ACTIVITIES,
WHETHER OR NOT FOR PROFIT OR FOR PRIVATE/PUBLIC ATTENDANCE, IN
WHICH THE TIMEFRAME OF THE SPECIAL EVENT DOES NOT EXCEEDS EVEN
CONSECUTIVE DAYS, OR A PORTION THERE OF.
